localBiteReport: The week of September 18–24, 2026 is shaping up to be one of the better inshore windows of the year around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay. Redfish are the star of the show right now — slot fish and oversized bulls are spread from the East Pass all the way into Santa Rosa Sound and the main bay, with live bait (scaled sardines, live shrimp, and croakers) working best around moving water and structure. Bait has become abundant and easy to catch in the area, and that bait presence is directly translating into improved action for trout and flounder alongside the reds. Capt. Adam Schroeder (Ignite the Bite Charters, Destin) called the current inshore bite one of the best he has seen all year. Water temp today at this location is 86°F — still warm, but the early-fall transition is underway and conditions should continue to improve through October.
